features.name: Patient Registration
features.description: Allow patients to create and manage their accounts in the system
user_stories: As a new patient, I want to register an account so that I can book appointments
As a registered patient, I want to update my profile information so that my records are current
acceptance_criteria: Patient can register with email, password, name, phone, and date of birth
System validates email uniqueness
Patient can log in with credentials
Patient can update profile information except email

features.name: Doctor Directory
features.description: Browse and search available doctors by specialty, name, or department
user_stories: As a patient, I want to browse doctors by specialty so that I can find the right healthcare provider
As a patient, I want to view doctor profiles so that I can learn about their qualifications
acceptance_criteria: System displays list of all active doctors
Patients can filter doctors by specialty
Patients can search doctors by name
Doctor profile shows name, specialty, qualifications, and available time slots

features.name: Appointment Scheduling
features.description: Enable patients to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments with doctors
user_stories: As a patient, I want to book an appointment with a doctor so that I can receive medical care
As a patient, I want to see available time slots so that I can choose a convenient time
As a patient, I want to cancel my appointment so that I can free up the slot if I cannot attend
acceptance_criteria: Patient can view available time slots for selected doctor
Patient can book an appointment for an available slot
System prevents double-booking of time slots
Patient can cancel appointment at least 24 hours in advance
Patient receives confirmation after booking

features.name: Appointment Management
features.description: View and manage upcoming and past appointments
user_stories: As a patient, I want to view my upcoming appointments so that I know when to visit
As a patient, I want to view my appointment history so that I can track my medical visits
acceptance_criteria: Patient can view list of upcoming appointments
Patient can view past appointment history
Appointments display doctor name, date, time, and status
Patient can filter appointments by status

features.name: Doctor Schedule Management
features.description: Allow doctors to set and manage their availability schedules
user_stories: As a doctor, I want to set my available hours so that patients can book appointments during those times
As a doctor, I want to block time slots so that I can manage my schedule
acceptance_criteria: Doctor can define weekly recurring availability
Doctor can block specific time slots
Doctor can view their appointment schedule
Changes to availability do not affect already booked appointments

features.name: Notification System
features.description: Send reminders and notifications to patients about appointments
user_stories: As a patient, I want to receive appointment reminders so that I don't forget my scheduled visit
As a patient, I want to receive booking confirmations so that I know my appointment is confirmed
acceptance_criteria: System sends email confirmation upon booking
System sends reminder 24 hours before appointment
System sends notification when appointment is cancelled
Patients can opt-in/out of notifications

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Administrative interface to manage doctors, patients, and system settings
user_stories: As an admin, I want to add new doctors to the system so that patients can book with them
As an admin, I want to view system statistics so that I can monitor usage
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create, update, and deactivate doctor accounts
Admin can view all appointments in the system
Admin can view patient and doctor counts
Admin can generate reports on appointment statistics

features.name: Medical Records Access
features.description: Allow patients to view their basic medical visit records
user_stories: As a patient, I want to view notes from my past appointments so that I can reference my medical history
acceptance_criteria: Patient can view visit notes for completed appointments
Only the patient and their doctor can view medical records
Records display date, doctor, and visit notes

constraints: System must comply with HIPAA regulations for patient data protection
Must support concurrent booking requests without conflicts
System must be accessible via web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Initial deployment supports single hospital location
Appointment slots are fixed at 30-minute intervals
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance
non_functional_requirements: System must respond to user requests within 2 seconds under normal load
System must support at least 1000 concurrent users
Patient data must be encrypted at rest and in transit
System must maintain 99.5% uptime during business hours
User interface must be responsive and mobile-friendly
System must maintain audit logs of all data modifications
Password must meet complexity requirements (8+ characters, mixed case, numbers)
Session timeout after 30 minutes of inactivity
System must perform daily automated backups
All user inputs must be validated and sanitized to prevent injection attacks
